visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey school-style uniform, sits on a cream-colored couch. She holds a Silver YouTube Creator Award with both hands, smiling broadly at the camera. The background is a plain indoor room with a white wall and a few pillows. (2) The scene cuts to a man wearing a black baseball cap and a black t-shirt. He holds a Gold YouTube Creator Award, leaning forward with an excited expression. In the blurry background, another individual sits at a table with a laptop under bright indoor lighting. (3) A man with long dark hair tied in a bun, wearing a white button-up shirt, is shown standing. He coughs into his hand before opening a professional black briefcase held at waist level. Inside the briefcase is a sparkling Diamond YouTube Creator Award against a foam interior. (4) The woman from the first scene and the man in the black cap are seen together in a medium shot. They both exhibit exaggerated shocked expressions with mouths open and eyes wide, looking towards the object revealed in the previous phase.
